title: Reletting Rate Scale for Lease Term Agreement Lease Breaks
content:
The reletting rate applied to the contracted rent in the reletting fee of a lease break on a Lease Term Agreement is set by the reletting months remaining: fewer than 4 months take a rate of 45 percent; 4 to 6 months take 65 percent; 7 months or more take the term program's reletting fee rate.

The scale is read for the Lease Term Agreement against which the open lease-break request stands — the lease-break request in submitted status, with the termination date asked for on it — and turns only on the number of reletting months remaining on that term.

## Scale

| Reletting months remaining | Reletting rate |
|---|---|
| 0 to 3 | 45 percent (0.45) |
| 4 to 6 | 65 percent (0.65) |
| 7 or more | the term program's reletting fee rate, below |

| Term program | Reletting fee rate |
|---|---|
| Month-to-Month Agreement | 0.00 |
| Short-Term Lease (3-5 Months) | 50 percent (0.5) |
| Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) | 70 percent (0.7) |
| Standard Lease (10-12 Months) | 85 percent (0.85) |
| Extended Lease (13-15 Months) | 85 percent (0.85) |
| Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) | 100 percent (1.00) |

## Boundaries (hypothetical, Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months), contracted rent 2,000.00 dollars)

| Reletting months remaining | Rate | Rate applied to the contracted rent |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 45 percent | 900.00 |
| 4 | 65 percent | 1,300.00 |
| 6 | 65 percent | 1,300.00 |
| 7 | 100 percent | 2,000.00 |
